name: TradingBoxing
summary: TradingBoxing is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies price consolidation ranges (boxing periods) and enters trades when price breaks out of the established range. It uses a structured approach to define upper and lower boundaries of recent price action, then trades the breakout direction with predefined risk parameters.
summary_zh: TradingBoxing是一个基于突破策略的智能交易系统，它识别价格盘整区间（箱体时期），并在价格突破已建立区间时入场交易。它使用结构化方法定义近期价格行为的上下边界，然后按突破方向进行交易。
strategy_analysis: TradingBoxing的策略核心是箱体突破，即在价格盘整形成箱体区间后，等待价格突破箱体上轨或下轨时入场。入场条件为价格收盘价突破箱体上边界时做多，突破下边界时做空。出场条件包括止盈和止损，通常在箱体对侧设置目标。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的方式，可能包含加仓逻辑。资金管理方面，止损通常设置在箱体内部或突破点反侧，控制单笔风险。策略依赖于市场盘整后的突破动能，在趋势明确的市场中表现较好，但在假突破频繁的震荡市场中可能遭受连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: TradingBoxing's core strategy is boxing breakout - it enters trades when price breaks above the upper boundary or below the lower boundary of a defined consolidation range. The entry condition requires the close price to break above the boxing upper rail for longs, or below the lower rail for shorts. Exit conditions include take-profit targets typically set at the opposite side of the boxing range and stop-loss levels. Position sizing may use fixed lots or percentage-based allocation relative to account equity. Money management involves setting stop-losses inside the boxing range or on the reverse side of the breakout point to control per-trade risk. The strategy relies on momentum following consolidation periods and performs well in trending markets, but may suffer consecutive losses in choppy markets with frequent false breakouts.

parameters.description_en: Consolidation box period, bars to determine range

parameters.name: LotSize

parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

parameters.description_en: Maximum allowed spread, no trade if exceeded

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，箱体突破是经典且经过验证的交易方法
具有止损和止盈设置，风险可控
包含点差过滤，避免在高点差环境下入场
参数化设计灵活，用户可调整箱体周期和风险参数
适用于多时间框架和多品种交易
pros_en: Clear and logical strategy - boxing breakout is a classic and well-validated trading method
Includes stop-loss and take-profit settings for controlled risk management
Contains spread filter to avoid entering trades in high-spread environments
Flexible parameterized design allowing users to adjust boxing period and risk parameters
Applicable across multiple timeframes and trading instruments
cons: 箱体突破策略在震荡市中容易遭受假突破导致连续亏损
缺乏趋势过滤机制，可能在逆势突破时入场
没有明确的仓位缩放机制，固定手数可能不适应不同账户规模
缺少多时间框架确认，单一周期突破信号可靠性有限
对盘整区间识别可能不够精确，边界判定存在主观性
cons_en: Boxing breakout strategy is vulnerable to false breakouts in choppy markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks trend filter mechanism, may enter on counter-trend breakouts
No explicit position scaling mechanism - fixed lot size may not suit different account sizes
Missing multi-timeframe confirmation reduces reliability of single-period breakout signals
Consolidation range identification may lack precision with subjective boundary determination
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX），仅在趋势方向突破时入场
加入多时间框架确认，提高突破信号可靠性
实现动态仓位管理，根据账户规模和波动率自动调整手数
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX) to only trade breakouts in the trend direction
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation to improve breakout signal reliability
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account size and market volatility

risk_points: 假突破风险：在震荡市场中价格可能突破后迅速回撤，导致止损被触发
固定止损可能不足以覆盖市场波动，特别是在重要新闻发布期间
缺少最大连续亏损限制和整体资金回撤控制机制
risk_points_en: False breakout risk: price may break out then quickly reverse in choppy markets triggering stop-losses
Fixed stop-loss may be insufficient to cover market volatility, especially during major news events
Lacks maximum consecutive loss limits and overall drawdown control mechanisms

summary_en: TradingBoxing is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies price consolidation ranges (boxing periods) and enters trades when price breaks out of the established range. It uses a structured approach to define upper and lower boundaries of recent price action, then trades the breakout direction with predefined risk parameters.
